cases.name: a stale graph detaches the rebuild and the hook returns at once
cases.cmd:
d={{FIX}}/autosync-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $d/graphify-out $d/src $d/bin; printf '{}' > $d/graphify-out/graph.json; touch -t 202001010000 $d/graphify-out/graph.json; echo 'class A {}' > $d/src/A.cs; printf '#!/bin/bash
sleep 3
touch "$2/graphify-out/graph.json"
echo updated
' > $d/bin/graphify; chmod +x $d/bin/graphify; s=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())'); printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | GRAPHIFY_REPO=$d GRAPHIFY_BIN=$d/bin/graphify GRAPHIFY_HOOK_LOG=/tmp/claude-autosync-log-{{SID}} GRAPHIFY_AUTOSYNC_LOCK=/tmp/claude-autosync-lock-{{SID}} bash .claude/hooks/graphify-autosync.sh; e=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())'); speed=$(python3 -c "print('fast' if $e-$s < 2 else 'slow')"); sleep 5; echo "$speed:$(grep -c 'update OK' /tmp/claude-autosync-log-{{SID}})"

cases.name: an up-to-date graph spawns nothing
cases.cmd: d={{FIX}}/autosync-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $d/graphify-out $d/src $d/bin; echo 'class A {}' > $d/src/A.cs; touch -t 202001010000 $d/src/A.cs; printf '{}' > $d/graphify-out/graph.json; printf '#!/bin/bash\necho never\n' > $d/bin/graphify; chmod +x $d/bin/graphify; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | GRAPHIFY_REPO=$d GRAPHIFY_BIN=$d/bin/graphify GRAPHIFY_HOOK_LOG=/tmp/claude-autosync-log-{{SID}} GRAPHIFY_AUTOSYNC_LOCK=/tmp/claude-autosync-lock-{{SID}} bash .claude/hooks/graphify-autosync.sh; tail -1 /tmp/claude-autosync-log-{{SID}}

cases.name: a missing graph is an alert, never a rebuild
cases.cmd: d={{FIX}}/autosync-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $d/src $d/bin; echo 'class A {}' > $d/src/A.cs; printf '#!/bin/bash\necho never\n' > $d/bin/graphify; chmod +x $d/bin/graphify; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | GRAPHIFY_REPO=$d GRAPHIFY_BIN=$d/bin/graphify GRAPHIFY_HOOK_LOG=/tmp/claude-autosync-log-{{SID}} GRAPHIFY_AUTOSYNC_LOCK=/tmp/claude-autosync-lock-{{SID}} bash .claude/hooks/graphify-autosync.sh; tail -1 /tmp/claude-autosync-log-{{SID}}
